name: qa_inserts
title: OS-INSFX S1 and S2, Inserts from the console: an effect module (kind 2) bound to a track insert with `diag ins`, heard, measured (`ins`, `cpu`), bypassed, reset and unbound while the transport plays. S3b: a console bind, unbind and bypass are written to the project (INSX): the last steps save, reset and check that a load binds them again (QA-GLB-173). Needs an effect module file on the card: modules/effects/example_effect.tmod (the SDK template, built by the tester). Writes the card only at the QA-GLB-173 save (the scratch project's folder). The Mixer INSERTS steps (OS-INSFX S4, QA-MIX-058..067, after the console steps) drive the screen and read the console back. Leaves no insert bound

steps.say: OS-INSFX S1, rows QA-GLB-161..167 of docs/qa/catalogue/global.md (a unit step is named by the row id its note begins with). Open the project the run is about (the Dense8 song of OS-DENSE, or any project with a sounding track 1) before the run, and put modules/effects/example_effect.tmod on the card. The insert is console-bound: it is lost on save and on reload until the project record lands (slice S3); `ins` says nothing about saving

steps.note: (Shift released, in case a former run left it down)
QA-GLB-161: the totals line with no insert bound: no insert line follows
the effect module is loaded (the kind is not shown: `ins bind` refuses an instrument)
QA-GLB-162: an effect module bound to track 1, slot 1 (the activation is applied at the next block boundary)

steps.expect: ins: bind DELETE THE INSERT FIRST
steps.note: QA-GLB-162: the same place twice is refused
QA-GLB-163: the insert is running (phase on); its measured cycles and share of the block are on the line
QA-GLB-163: the load with the insert on; the insert's cycles are inside the render figure (the governor's base)
QA-GLB-163: the totals line again: nothing was forced to dry
QA-GLB-164: bypass is a one-block ramp to the dry signal, no click
QA-GLB-164
QA-GLB-164: off is a reset of the effect (shutdown, init, its parameters) through the swap protocol: the module's tail starts again from silence
QA-GLB-164

QA-GLB-167: `tail` is also shown while the source is live (the effect returns 1); right after the stop it still reads `tail` (with example_effect until its output has been exactly 0 for 2 s of silent source; a feedback effect would ring for its own time)
QA-GLB-167: 5 s later (the release plus the 2 s zero rule) there is no `tail` word: the strip is idle again
QA-GLB-167: the render figure is a stopped transport's, with the insert bound and idle (nothing of the insert is run)
QA-GLB-165: unbind is a one-block ramp to dry, then the module is shut down once the render is clear of it
QA-GLB-165
QA-GLB-165: the counters: retired 1 or more, params and stale in the totals line
QA-GLB-165: underruns 0 over the run (read it against the first read)

expect: BENCH insert \d+ 64 avg \d+ max \d+ \(.*, adapter \d+ cycles \(\d+\.\d%\) peak \d+\)
steps.note: QA-GLB-166: bench image, transport stopped, example_effect still loaded: the adapter's cost is the number after `adapter` (insert minus insert_effect)

steps.say: OS-INSFX S3b, row QA-GLB-173 (and QA-FIL-138): inserts are saved with the project and bound again when it loads. Use a SCRATCH project of your own (a copy such as Projects/t-v16-copy, never the original), open on the unit with modules/effects/example_effect.tmod on the card. Below: bind two inserts (one bypassed), save with the File screen, reset the unit, and check that the unit's own project open after boot brings both back. The save writes the project folder on the card.

steps.note: QA-GLB-173: the scratch project the S3b steps change and save: Projects/t-v16-copy (loaded here, so the binds below are written to a project that is open; never the original Projects/t-v16)
(a former run's insert, if any, is removed: `NO INSERT HERE` is also fine)
(the same)
the effect module is loaded
QA-GLB-173: track 1 slot 1 (written to the project: the project is now changed)
QA-GLB-173: track 2 slot 2
QA-GLB-173: the second one is bypassed (the flag is written to the project)
QA-GLB-173: both are bound before the save; the second reads `bypassed, bypass`

steps.say: QA-GLB-173 BY HAND: SAVE the project on the File screen (the strip says it is saved; wait for it to finish). Then POWER-CYCLE THE UNIT (a scenario may not send `reset`): the project open at power-on (OS-BOOTLAST) is the one just saved. Load the same project instead if the unit does not reopen the last one: `load Projects/<its folder>`.
QA-GLB-173: after the power cycle wait for the Pattern screen and for the project to open (the strip says PROJECT ... OPENED), then continue.

steps.note: QA-GLB-173: after the boot both inserts are bound again by the project load (no `mod load` or `ins bind` was typed), module example_effect, and the second is still bypassed

steps.say: QA-GLB-173 BY HAND: the boot log of that start has the line `inserts: 2, 2 bound, 0 skipped` after the `modules:` line (its own line: a log line holds 55 characters; `sd` prints only the project load summary, not this line). QA-GLB-173 BY HAND, the previous firmware: put a build from before S3a on the same card and open the same project: it plays without the inserts and opens normally; save it there; open it again in this build: both inserts are back (the older build keeps the chunk byte for byte).

steps.note: QA-GLB-173: cleanup, the project record goes too (do not save it again if the inserts are meant to stay)
QA-GLB-173: cleanup

steps.say: OS-INSFX S4, rows QA-MIX-058 to QA-MIX-067 of docs/qa/catalogue/mixer.md (a unit step is named by the row id its note begins with; the steps above are the console's, they leave no insert bound). The Mixer's INSERTS page: put modules/effects/biquad.tmod on the card (the build's modules/biquad.tmod), reset the unit, open the project the run is about (the Dense8 song of OS-DENSE, or any project with sound on tracks 1..3) and press Play only where a step says so. Writes the card only at the QA-MIX-065 save, by hand (a scratch copy of the project)

steps.note: (Shift released, in case a former run left it down)

QA-MIX-058: F6 on the Mixer is the INSERTS page: 16 tracks (12 listed with the project's) and MASTER by INS A / INS B, every cell empty (`-`), the soft key row MIXER ROUTING MST FX STEMS CUE LVL INSERTS BYPASS SOLO

QA-MIX-059: Insert on T2 INS A opens the picker titled INSERT T2 A: one line per module of modules/effects, each with its cost (UNMEASURED until it has run, or the figure of the last bind) and its state; the build's biquad is there
QA-MIX-060: F1 binds the effect: the picker closes, the strip says INSERT SET and the cell reads the module's name
QA-MIX-060: the console reads back the insert the screen made (one path, no second write)
QA-MIX-061: playing, the cell shows the measured cost of the insert (~N% or <1%) of the block, read against `ins` and `cpu`; a bypassed or idle insert shows its cost as it was
QA-MIX-061: the cycles and the share of the block on the line are what the cell prints
QA-MIX-062: F7 BYPASS marks the cell bypassed and the strip says INSERT BYPASSED; the track sounds dry (by ear: the filter is gone, no click)
QA-MIX-062: the host's bypass flag follows

steps.say: QA-MIX-063, by hand: with the insert live, `Insert` on its cell says DELETE THE INSERT FIRST and opens no picker. Fill all four inserts (T2 A, T2 B, T3 A, T3 B), then `Insert` on a fifth cell says INSERTS FULL. `Insert` on MASTER says MASTER INSERT: NOT YET. Then move the cursor away and back: the cells keep their names

steps.note: QA-MIX-064: Delete removes the insert: the cell is empty, the strip says INSERT DELETED
QA-MIX-064: the console no longer lists track 2 slot 1

steps.say: QA-MIX-065, by hand: assign biquad to T2 INS A, SAVE the project (File), load it again: the INSERTS page lists the insert with its name and bypass state and the console's `ins` shows it bound (S3). Delete a module's file from the card, reload: the cell shows its name greyed and F7 says MODULE MISSING: DELETE OR RELOAD; Insert on the cell says DELETE THE INSERT FIRST; Delete removes the record
QA-MIX-066, by hand: the Insert picker lists a module the project names and the card lacks greyed, MISSING FROM THE CARD, and F1 on it says MODULE MISSING
QA-MIX-067, by hand with `diag bench`: an insert over its CPU budget is forced to dry by the governor: the cell shows OVER BUDGET, F7 clears it (NO CPU is the answer while the block is still full)

QA-MIX-070, by hand: with an insert on T2 INS A, press Delete and at once Insert, pick biquad, F1 on the same cell: the strip says INSERT LEAVING: TRY AGAIN and nothing is bound; a moment later the same pick says INSERT SET. The console's `ins bind` right after an `ins unbind` says the same.

QA-MIX-071, by hand: take modules/effects/*.tmod off the card (or run without a card), reset, open the INSERTS page, Insert on an empty cell: the picker has no line from the card (a module the project names in an insert and the card lacks is greyed), F1 says NO SUCH EFFECT and nothing is bound.

steps.note: (leaves no insert bound, whatever the steps above left)
